description: This Java class defines allergy-related properties in the OpenMRS healthcare system, providing methods to retrieve specific allergy concept data via global properties.

classes.name: AllergyProperties
classes.description: Provider of allergy-related concept properties, fetching concepts based on global property configurations.

methods.name: getConceptByGlobalProperty
methods.description: Internal helper method to retrieve a Concept object based on a global property name, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: getMildSeverityConcept
methods.description: Retrieves the concept representing mild allergy severity.

methods.name: getModerateSeverityConcept
methods.description: Retrieves the concept representing moderate allergy severity.

methods.name: getSevereSeverityConcept
methods.description: Retrieves the concept representing severe allergy severity.

methods.name: getFoodAllergensConcept
methods.description: Retrieves the concept representing food allergens.

methods.name: getDrugAllergensConcept
methods.description: Retrieves the concept representing drug allergens.

methods.name: getEnvironmentAllergensConcept
methods.description: Retrieves the concept representing environmental allergens.

methods.name: getAllergyReactionsConcept
methods.description: Retrieves the concept representing allergy reactions.

methods.name: getOtherNonCodedConcept
methods.description: Retrieves the concept for non-coded allergy information.

methods.name: getUnknownConcept
methods.description: Retrieves the concept representing unknown allergy information.
